chunks: O you who believe, if you help (in the cause of) God He will surely come to your aid, and firmly plant your feet.

key_terms.تَنْصُرُوا اللَّهَ: You help God (by supporting His cause)
key_terms.يُثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَكُمْ: He will make your feet firm/steadfast

ai.seo_question: What is the condition for God's help and firmness of steps in Surah Muhammad?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *Tawhid* in action, where human agency (*Fa'il*) cooperates with divine will (*Mufid*), particularly highlighted in the context of the Prophet's and Imams' struggles. The promise of 'steadfastness' (*Yuthabbit aqdama-kum*) is interpreted not merely as physical stability but as spiritual firmness against doubt and hypocrisy, a theme central to the Ahl al-Bayt's teachings on *Thabat* during trials.
